not sure if I'm the experienced one here, still learning and working, but I think this question can not be answered exactly. You know, there are profit trades and losing trades. Only you have to look at charts and find out, which engulf you will be taking on your trading style basis. For example I'm taking every move and my charakter is very aggresive, but mabye you have to follow your charakter and wait after price has made some pretty long rally with lots of HH and HL, than you got an engulf, price make new QM level, FTR and than you will set a pending order and finaly make a trade.
